name: voc_sgp41
title: VOC sensor
purpose: VOC and NOx gas sensor, Sensirion SGP41 on I2C, with the datasheet's RC decoupling

sources.title: Sensirion SGP41 datasheet, version 1.0 (December 2021)
sources.licence: copyright Sensirion: link and quotes only
sources.read: p1 package, p8 typical application circuit and pin assignment, p12 I2C address, p19 land pattern

sources.title: KiCad 10 standard libraries (symbols, footprints, 3D models)
sources.read: symbol pin numbers, footprint pads, 3D models

parts.source: sgp41, p8 (pins), p19 (land pattern); symbol and footprint drawn for the harness (KiCad has neither)
parts.quote: pins: "1 VDD, 2 VSS, 3 SDA, 4 n/a Connect to ground (no electrical function), 5 VDDH, 6 SCL"; "The die pad or center pad is electrically connected to GND."
parts.pin_types_why: sgp41 p8: pin 4 "Connect to ground (no electrical function)"

parts.quote: "The VDD pin must be decoupled with an RC element." Figure 6: 4.7 Ω from the supply to VDD
Figure 6: 1 µF from VDD to ground
"The required decoupling for VDDH depends on the power supply network connected to the sensor, a capacitor of 1 µF is recommended." (Figure 6: 1 µF)

+3V3.note: VDD and VDDH 1.7-3.6 V, "connected to one single supply" (sgp41 p8)

layout.rules: I2C address 0x59 (sgp41 p12). Keep out of bright light (sgp41 p8: "should not be exposed to bright illumination").

open_questions: Footprint drawn from Figure 18 for this board; not yet compared with Sensirion's own CAD files (no licence stated on them).
